limitations: First row is a reference; preceding initial interval is excluded from all integrals.
Samples are completed synchronous game-physics-frame endpoints, not internal Chaos-substep states or mathematical continuous trajectories.
Each observer/baseline pair has the same controlled game FPS. Different FPS trajectories are not claimed equal.
Electrical energy is integrated model output, independently recalculated from CSV V/I/dt; it is not measured battery energy or mechanical work.
No fixed120 flight, physical USB, other physical PC, GPU performance or photoreal rendering validation.
Derived normalized-dot/acos angular residual may be nonzero even for byte-identical quaternion fields.
Existing CSV guard is an explicit pre-open check; runners use unique output directories. No atomic cross-process output ownership claim.
